# `morphir package publish`

- **Usage:** `morphir package publish <FLAGS>`

Commit exact caller-signed successor metadata for a Library

## Flags
- **`--bundle <DIR>`** — Exact Library bundle passed to package registry prepare
- **`--release <DIR>`** — Exact signed Library release passed to package registry prepare
- **`--predecessor <FILE>`** — predecessor.json from package registry prepare
- **`--proposal <FILE>`** — Caller-signed proposal from package registry sign-proposal
- **`--policy <FILE>`** — Trust policy used when initializing the registry
- **`--registry <DIR>`** — Existing local registry directory
- **`--publisher-state <DIR>`** — Existing private publisher-state directory
- **`--json`**
